summary_en: FY12/26 year-end dividend raised from ¥51 to ¥93 per share (+42 yen, +83%). Full-year dividend guidance increased to ¥144/share. Payout ratio floor 30%+ maintained. Upward revision of H1 and full-year earnings drove increase.
title_en: Notification of Revision to FY12/26 2Q (Interim) and Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Bell-Park Co., Ltd. raised its FY12/26 year-end dividend forecast from ¥51 to ¥93 per share, an increase of ¥42 per share or 83%. Full-year dividend guidance was raised to ¥144 per share from ¥102 per share. The increase follows upward revision of earnings forecasts: H1 operating profit raised to ¥5,000M (from ¥2,700M forecast), and full-year consolidated net profit rose to ¥4,650M (from ¥3,300M forecast). Company cited stronger revenue in carrier shop and corporate solutions business in the first half, offset by planned increases in promotional spending, personnel costs, and system investments in H2 to support future recurring revenue. The company maintains a consolidated payout ratio floor of 30% as its core dividend policy.
